title: The phone number sign-in's waiting screens and backing out are never tested
what: No test shows 'Looking for your gym...', 'Send the message in WhatsApp' or the 'You pay nothing, and we never message you.' line, and none backs out of the waiting screen to check the number is kept and a late answer opens no gym. The phone test uses a made-up answer that skips the wait. The pass member's 'You train there on a pass.' card is never seen either.
expected: A test should show the waiting and looking screens, the pass card, and that backing out keeps the number and stops the old check.
fix_line: Add a check for the waiting and looking screens and for backing out of them

title: Going back after 'Try another way' is never tested
what: Every test that opens 'Try another way' carries on forward. None presses Back to check the other ways fold away to the phone button only, and that a second Back leaves the app without saving anything.
expected: A test should press Back with the other ways open and check what shows.
fix_line: Add a Back press after 'Try another way' to the phone sign-in test

title: No test checks gym staff using the member app are told before joining as a member
what: Tests prove an owner, trainer or desk number is found with its role and never joined automatically. None checks what the screen then tells them, that tapping Join does not make them a paying member without a word, or that the member app gives them no staff powers.
expected: A test should sign in by number as an owner and as desk staff and check the words, the join result and that no staff tools appear.
fix_line: Add an owner and a desk staff run to the phone sign-in test

title: The setup questions' own words and the failed-save message are never checked
what: No test checks 'Three quick questions and you are training...', 'Your goal and experience', 'Setting up...' on the button, 'Keep your name under 60 characters.', the 'Any country. Only for your gym...' line or 'Could not save your details. Please try again.'. Nothing taps Start training twice to check only one profile is made, or checks the unit pick survives going back.
expected: A test should check these words on screen and the double tap.
fix_line: Add the setup words and a double tap to the welcome phone test

title: The demo's badge, its question words and its failure message are never checked
what: The 'Demo data loaded' badge is only ever checked as missing, never as shown after a load. The 'Load demo data?' words, 'Replace with demo', 'Loading demo...' and 'Could not load the demo. Please try again.' are never checked, and no test cancels the welcome sheet to check nothing changed.
expected: A test should load the demo and see the badge, the sheet words and a failed load.
fix_line: Add a check that the badge shows after loading the demo, and of the sheet words

title: Removing the demo: the caption, the Workout tab way in, cancel and failure words are never tested
what: No test shows the caption 'This app is showing a sample member...', the 'Removing...' state, or the remove sheet opened from the Workout tab. None cancels the sheet, and 'Could not remove the demo. Nothing was changed.' is never checked. Only the one-workout case is run on screen.
expected: A test should open the remove sheet from both places, cancel it, and fail a removal.
fix_line: Add the Workout tab sheet, a cancel and a failed removal to the demo test

title: Import replace failures, the undo window and Health Connect timing are never tested
what: No test checks 'Couldn't keep a copy of your workouts first...', 'The import failed. Nothing was changed...', 'Couldn't undo the import...' or 'Demo removed, history imported'. Nothing checks that Undo goes away after leaving, or that imported workouts reach Health Connect only after the undo window.
expected: Tests should fail each step and check the words, and check the undo ends and the Health Connect send waits.
fix_line: Add failure and undo-window checks to the import tests

title: Making an exercise with a name already in the library is never tested
what: The 'Already in your library' message for a second Bench Press has no test, nor a double tap on Create, nor an own exercise still being there after the app is closed, nor the save button naming what is missing.
expected: A test should try a duplicate name, a double tap and a restart.
fix_line: Add a duplicate name and a restart to the exercise library test

title: The straight-in note's buttons and the no-internet join are never tested on screen
what: The note 'We set you up as ...' is seen once, but no test taps 'Open Profile' or 'Got it', or closes and reopens the app to check it stays gone. A join with no internet is checked only by finding a line of code.
expected: A test should tap both buttons, reopen the app, and join with no internet.
fix_line: Add the note buttons and an offline join to the phone sign-in test

title: Erase's busy, failure and gym-told-later steps are never seen, and a named cover test does not exist
what: No test shows 'Erasing...', the caption 'Deletes everything on this phone...' or 'Could not erase your data. Nothing was deleted.'. Nothing checks the gym is really told on the next start after an offline erase. The phone test says the signed-in choice is covered by a unit test file that is not in the repo.
expected: Tests should show the busy and failure words and check the gym is told later; the named file should exist or the note be fixed.
fix_line: Add the erase failure words and the offline gym step to the tests, and fix the missing test file note
